notes: Fix: the drift-corrected velocity curve no longer changes pauses. Up to 3.12.0, when the corrected curve of a rep arrived, the pause just before the rep could turn from 0 into a non-zero velocity on the chart (up to about 0.7 m/s on recorded sets). Per-rep values (mean and peak velocity, displacement): on 5 recorded squat sets, replayed offline, they are identical to 3.12.0. BLE packet formats and serial log unchanged. Tools: the full_replay harness can print the CorrectedCurve chunks (ODKI_DUMP_CHUNKS). Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md Known limitation: the sensor samples at about 95 Hz instead of 100 Hz (velocities are not biased; sample-counted windows are about 5 percent longer); a fix is planned.
